name: IOF inspired
description: Inspired by the IOF brand, not an approved IOF graphic: frosted plates tinted from IOF Blue with soft glows drifting inside, white class tabs and red accents, a band of light on entry, red-over-green hairlines, Franklin Gothic-style heavy numerals. Elevation: a runner on the way rises as a white card above the plate and settles down when the time is confirmed.
author: Split Control, inspired by the IOF brand
fonts: Libre Franklin (OFL), bundled; it stands in for Franklin Gothic Heavy and Book
